```{r Helper Functions definition}

# Base UMAP theme
umap_pub_theme <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      axis.line        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      plot.margin      = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}

# UMAP axis arrows
add_umap_arrows <- function(umap_df) {
  x_range   <- diff(range(umap_df$UMAP_1))
  y_range   <- diff(range(umap_df$UMAP_2))
  arrow_x   <- 3.0
  arrow_y   <- arrow_x * (y_range / x_range)
  list(
    annotate("segment",
             x = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)+0.2, xend = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)+0.2+arrow_x,
             y = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)+0.2, yend = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)+0.2,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2,"cm"), type = "closed"),
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    annotate("segment",
             x = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)+0.2, xend = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)+0.2,
             y = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)+0.2, yend = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)+0.2+arrow_y,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2,"cm"), type = "closed"),
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    annotate("text",
             x = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)+0.2+arrow_x/2,
             y = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)-0.5,
             label = "UMAP-1", size = 3, color = "black",
             hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold"),
    annotate("text",
             x = min(umap_df$UMAP_1)-0.5,
             y = min(umap_df$UMAP_2)+0.2+arrow_y/2,
             label = "UMAP-2", size = 3, color = "black",
             hjust = 0.5, angle = 90, fontface = "bold")
  )
}

# Bar chart theme
bar_pub_theme <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                       size = 9, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 9, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.border     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.margin      = margin(10, 10, 5, 10)
    )
}

#Save helper (PDF)
save_pub <- function(p, filename, dir,
                      width = 180, height = 130) {
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), plot = p, path = dir,
         device = "pdf",
         width = width, height = height, units = "mm")
}
```

```{r Load MERTK adult object and run ImmGen}

# Loading the adult-only integrated object
seurat_integrated <- readRDS(
  "/projects/b1246/Isaac/MERTK/v2_adults_only/data/02_integration/seurat_adults_harmony.rds"
)

cat("Loaded seurat_integrated:", ncol(seurat_integrated), "cells\n")
cat("Samples:", table(seurat_integrated$sample), "\n")

#Build SCE for ImmGen
DefaultAssay(seurat_integrated) <- "RNA"
seurat_integrated <- JoinLayers(seurat_integrated)

expr_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_integrated, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
expr_counts  <- expr_counts[!duplicated(rownames(expr_counts)), ]

adult_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = expr_counts))
adult_sce <- logNormCounts(adult_sce)

cat("SCE built:", ncol(adult_sce), "cells\n")

# Load ImmGen reference 
immgen_ref <- celldex::ImmGenData()
cat("ImmGen reference loaded\n")

#Find common genes
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(adult_sce), rownames(immgen_ref))

adult_sce_sub  <- adult_sce[common_genes, ]
immgen_ref_sub <- immgen_ref[common_genes, ]

#Run SingleR with ImmGen 
pred_immgen <- SingleR(
  test            = adult_sce_sub,
  ref             = immgen_ref_sub,
  labels          = immgen_ref_sub$label.main,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref  = "logcounts"
)

print(sort(table(pred_immgen$labels), decreasing = TRUE))

#Add ImmGen labels to Seurat object
seurat_integrated$ImmGen_label <- pred_immgen$labels


#Load classifier results and add to seurat_integrated 
classifier_results <- read.csv(
  "/projects/b1246/Isaac/MERTK/v2_adults_only/data/03_clustering/classifier_results.csv"
)

print(head(classifier_results))

# Set rownames to cell IDs for indexing
rownames(classifier_results) <- classifier_results$cell_id

#Check overlap with seurat_integrated
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(seurat_integrated),
                           classifier_results$cell_id)

# Add classifier labels back to seurat_integrated
seurat_integrated$classifier_label <- classifier_results[
  colnames(seurat_integrated), "predicted_celltype"
]
seurat_integrated$classifier_prob <- classifier_results[
  colnames(seurat_integrated), "max_probability"
]

print(sort(table(seurat_integrated$classifier_label), decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r Comparison dataframe}

# Extract UMAP coordinates
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(seurat_integrated, "umap"))
colnames(umap_df) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

comp_df <- data.frame(
  cell_id         = colnames(seurat_integrated),
  UMAP_1          = umap_df$UMAP_1,
  UMAP_2          = umap_df$UMAP_2,
  sample          = seurat_integrated$sample,
  custom_label    = seurat_integrated$classifier_label,
  custom_prob     = seurat_integrated$classifier_prob,
  immgen_label    = seurat_integrated$ImmGen_label,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Comparison dataframe built:", nrow(comp_df), "cells\n")
cat("Custom labels:", length(unique(comp_df$custom_label)), "\n")
cat("ImmGen labels:", length(unique(comp_df$immgen_label)), "\n")

#Broad category mapping for custom classifier
custom_to_broad <- c(
  "CCR2+ Mac"                = "Macrophages",
  "ARG1+ Mac"                = "Macrophages",
  "MHCII Mac"                = "Macrophages",
  "TLF Mac"                  = "Macrophages",
  "Prolif TLF Mac"           = "Macrophages",
  "Ly6C-hi Mono"             = "Monocytes",
  "Ly6C-lo Mono"             = "Monocytes",
  "Neutrophils"              = "Neutrophils",
  "DCs"                      = "DCs",
  "B Cells"                  = "Lymphoid",
  "NKT"                      = "Lymphoid",
  "ECs"                      = "Endothelial",
  "Arterial ECs"             = "Endothelial",
  "Venous ECs"               = "Endothelial",
  "Fibroblasts"              = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "Fibroblast progenitors"   = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "RCFs"                     = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "Prolif RCFs"              = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "Transitional fibroblasts" = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "Matrifibrocytes"          = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "Ccl2 fibroblasts"         = "Fibroblast/Stromal",
  "VSMCs"                    = "VSMCs",
  "Cardiomyocytes"           = "Cardiomyocytes",
  "Unassigned"               = "Unassigned"
)

#Broad category mapping for ImmGen
normalize_immgen <- function(label) {
  case_when(
    grepl("Macrophage",        label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Macrophages",
    grepl("Monocyte",          label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Monocytes",
    grepl("Neutrophil",        label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Neutrophils",
    grepl("Dendritic",         label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "DCs",
    grepl("B cell",            label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lymphoid",
    grepl("T cell|NK|NKT|ILC|Tgd", label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lymphoid",
    grepl("Endothel",          label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Endothelial",
    grepl("Fibro|Stromal",     label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Fibroblast/Stromal",
    grepl("Mast|Basophil|Eosinophil", label, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Other Immune",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

comp_df$custom_broad <- custom_to_broad[comp_df$custom_label]
comp_df$custom_broad[is.na(comp_df$custom_broad)] <- "Unassigned"
comp_df$immgen_broad  <- normalize_immgen(comp_df$immgen_label)

cat("\nCustom broad distribution:\n")
print(sort(table(comp_df$custom_broad), decreasing = TRUE))
cat("\nImmGen broad distribution:\n")
print(sort(table(comp_df$immgen_broad), decreasing = TRUE))






```


```{r Side-by-side UMAP: Custom vs ImmGen}


broad_colors <- c(
  "Macrophages"        = "#C0392B",
  "Monocytes"          = "#E67E22",
  "Neutrophils"        = "#0072B2",
  "DCs"                = "#56B4E9",
  "Lymphoid"           = "#2980B9",
  "Endothelial"        = "#27AE60",
  "Fibroblast/Stromal" = "#8E44AD",
  "VSMCs"              = "#E91E8C",
  "Cardiomyocytes"     = "#7A9134",
  "Other Immune"       = "#95A5A6",
  "Unassigned"         = "grey80",
  "Other"              = "grey80"
)

# Custom classifier UMAP
centroids_custom <- comp_df %>%
  filter(custom_broad != "Unassigned") %>%
  group_by(custom_broad) %>%
  summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1),
            UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2), .groups = "drop")

centroids_custom <- centroids_custom %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP_1 = case_when(
      custom_broad == "Lymphoid" ~ UMAP_1 - 2,  # shift left
      TRUE ~ UMAP_1
    ),
    UMAP_2 = case_when(
      custom_broad == "Lymphoid" ~ UMAP_2 - 8.0,  # shift down
      TRUE ~ UMAP_2
    )
  )

centroids_immgen <- comp_df %>%
  filter(immgen_broad != "Other") %>%
  group_by(immgen_broad) %>%
  summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1),
            UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2), .groups = "drop")

p_custom_umap <- ggplot(
  comp_df[order(comp_df$custom_broad == "Unassigned",
                decreasing = TRUE), ],
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = custom_broad)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 1.0, stroke = 0) +   
  scale_color_manual(values = broad_colors,
                     guide = guide_legend(
                       override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1),
                       ncol = 1)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = centroids_custom,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = custom_broad),
                  color = "black", size = 3, fontface = "bold",
                  box.padding = 0.4, segment.color = "grey50",
                  segment.size = 0.3, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
  umap_pub_theme() +
  add_umap_arrows(comp_df) 

p_immgen_umap <- ggplot(
  comp_df[order(comp_df$immgen_broad == "Other",
                decreasing = TRUE), ],
  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = immgen_broad)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 1.0, stroke = 0) +   
  scale_color_manual(values = broad_colors,
                     guide = guide_legend(
                       override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1),
                       ncol = 1)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = centroids_immgen,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = immgen_broad),
                  color = "black", size = 3, fontface = "bold",
                  box.padding = 0.4, segment.color = "grey50",
                  segment.size = 0.3, max.overlaps = 20, seed = 42) +
  umap_pub_theme() +
  add_umap_arrows(comp_df) 

p_umap_comparison <- p_custom_umap | p_immgen_umap
p_umap_comparison

save_pub(p_umap_comparison, "Fig1_UMAP_Custom_vs_ImmGen",
         comparison_dir, width = 320, height = 130)
```

```{r Confusion heatmap: Custom broad vs ImmGen broad}

#Showing agreement and disagreement 

# Only cells assigned by custom classifier
assigned_cells <- comp_df[comp_df$custom_label != "Unassigned", ]

conf_mat <- prop.table(
  table(Custom = assigned_cells$custom_broad,
        ImmGen = assigned_cells$immgen_broad),
  margin = 1
)

# Order rows and columns
row_order <- c("Macrophages","Monocytes","Neutrophils","DCs",
               "Lymphoid","Endothelial","Fibroblast/Stromal",
               "VSMCs","Cardiomyocytes")
col_order <- c("Macrophages","Monocytes","Neutrophils","DCs",
               "Lymphoid","Endothelial","Fibroblast/Stromal",
               "Other Immune","Other")

conf_mat <- conf_mat[
  intersect(row_order, rownames(conf_mat)),
  intersect(col_order, colnames(conf_mat)),
  drop = FALSE
]

# Heatmap
p_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  conf_mat,
  color            = colorRampPalette(c("white","#C0392B"))(100),
  display_numbers  = round(conf_mat, 2),
  number_format    = "%.2f",
  number_color     = "black",
  fontsize          = 10,
  fontsize_number   = 9,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  angle_col         = 45,
  border_color      = "grey90",
  main              = "",
  silent            = FALSE
)

p_heatmap 

save_pub(p_heatmap$gtable, "Fig2_Confusion_Heatmap",
         comparison_dir, width = 200, height = 160)
```



```{r Assignment rate comparison}

# Assignment rates: custom classifier vs ImmGen

# Custom classifier assignment stats
custom_assigned <- sum(comp_df$custom_label != "Unassigned")
custom_unassigned <- sum(comp_df$custom_label == "Unassigned")

# ImmGen always assigns 
immgen_assigned <- nrow(comp_df)

# ImmGen "Macrophage" calls not labeled macrophage by the classifier
immgen_mac_calls <- comp_df[comp_df$immgen_broad == "Macrophages", ]
true_macs <- sum(immgen_mac_calls$custom_broad == "Macrophages") 
false_macs <- sum(immgen_mac_calls$custom_broad != "Macrophages")
false_mac_pct <- round(false_macs / nrow(immgen_mac_calls) * 100, 1)

cat("=== Assignment Comparison ===\n")
cat("Custom: assigned", custom_assigned, "/", nrow(comp_df),
    "(", round(custom_assigned/nrow(comp_df)*100,1), "%)\n")
cat("ImmGen: assigned", immgen_assigned, "/", nrow(comp_df), "(100%)\n")
    false_macs, "(", false_mac_pct, "%)\n")

#Comparison bar chart
assignment_df <- data.frame(
  Classifier = c("Custom\nClassifier","Custom\nClassifier",
                  "ImmGen\nReference","ImmGen\nReference"),
  Category   = c("Confidently assigned","Unassigned / low confidence",
                  "True macrophages","Misclassified"),
  Cells      = c(custom_assigned, custom_unassigned,
                  true_macs, false_macs),
  Fill       = c("#27AE60","grey70","#27AE60","#C0392B")
)

p_assignment <- ggplot(
  assignment_df[assignment_df$Classifier == "Custom\nClassifier", ],
  aes(x = Category, y = Cells, fill = Fill)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     limits = c(0, nrow(comp_df) * 1.1)) +
  bar_pub_theme() +

p_immgen_accuracy <- ggplot(
  assignment_df[assignment_df$Classifier == "ImmGen\nReference", ],
  aes(x = Category, y = Cells, fill = Fill)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  bar_pub_theme() +
  ylab("Cell count") + xlab("")

p_assignment_comparison <- p_assignment | p_immgen_accuracy
p_assignment_comparison



save_pub(p_assignment_comparison, "Fig3_Assignment_Comparison",
```

```{r ImmGen misclassification breakdown}

non_mac_types <- c("Ly6C-hi Mono","Ly6C-lo Mono","B Cells","NKT",
                    "Neutrophils","DCs","ECs","Arterial ECs","Venous ECs",
                    "Fibroblasts","RCFs","VSMCs","Cardiomyocytes",
                    "Transitional fibroblasts","Matrifibrocytes")

misclass_df <- comp_df %>%
  filter(custom_label %in% non_mac_types) %>%
  group_by(custom_label) %>%
  summarise(
    total         = n(),
    called_mac    = sum(immgen_broad == "Macrophages"),
    pct_called_mac = round(called_mac / total * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total >= 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_called_mac))

misclass_df$custom_label <- factor(misclass_df$custom_label,
                                    levels = misclass_df$custom_label)

p_misclass <- ggplot(misclass_df,
                      aes(x = custom_label,
                          y = pct_called_mac,
                          fill = pct_called_mac)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(called_mac, " cells\n(",
                                pct_called_mac, "%)")),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, max(misclass_df$pct_called_mac) * 1.4)) +

                       guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),

  ylab("% called 'Macrophages' by ImmGen")

p_misclass


save_pub(p_misclass, "Fig4_ImmGen_Misclassification_Rate",
```

```{r Highlight UMAPs: ImmGen macrophage calls}

make_highlight_umap <- function(df, cell_type, correct_color) {
  
  df$status <- "Other"
  df$status[df$custom_label == cell_type &
              df$immgen_broad != "Macrophages"] <- paste0(cell_type, " (correct)")
  df$status[df$custom_label == cell_type &
              df$immgen_broad == "Macrophages"] <- paste0(cell_type, " → 'Macrophages'")

  # Build color vector with dynamic names using setNames
  colors <- setNames(
    c("grey88", correct_color, "#C0392B"),
    c("Other",
      paste0(cell_type, " (correct)"),
      paste0(cell_type, " → 'Macrophages'"))
  )

  df_ordered <- df[order(df$status == "Other", decreasing = TRUE), ]

  ggplot(df_ordered,
         aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = status)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 1.0, stroke = 0) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors,
                       guide = guide_legend(
                         override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    umap_pub_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
    add_umap_arrows(df) +
    annotate("text",
             x = min(df$UMAP_1), y = max(df$UMAP_2),
             label = cell_type, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
             size = 3.5, fontface = "bold")
}

#Build panels
p_dc <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "DCs", "#E67E22")
p_lo_mono <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "Ly6C-lo Mono", "#F39C12")
p_bcells  <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "B Cells",      "#2980B9")
p_nkt     <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "NKT",          "#CC79A7")
p_vsmc    <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "VSMCs",        "#E91E8C")
p_cardio  <- make_highlight_umap(comp_df, "Cardiomyocytes","#7A9134")

p_highlight_panel <- (p_dc | p_lo_mono | p_bcells) /

p_highlight_panel
```

```{r Precision-Prevalence analysis }


# Calculate metrics per custom cell type
all_types <- unique(comp_df$custom_label)
all_types <- all_types[all_types != "Unassigned"]
total_cells <- nrow(comp_df)
immgen_mac_total <- sum(comp_df$immgen_broad == "Macrophages")

prev_prec_df <- lapply(all_types, function(ct) {
  ct_cells  <- comp_df$custom_label == ct
  n_true    <- sum(ct_cells)
  tp        <- sum(ct_cells & comp_df$immgen_broad == "Macrophages")

  data.frame(
    CellType   = ct,
    N          = n_true,
    Prevalence = n_true / total_cells * 100,
    # Sensitivity: of true cells, % ImmGen got right
    Sensitivity = if (n_true > 0)
      sum(ct_cells & comp_df$immgen_broad ==
            normalize_immgen(unique(comp_df$immgen_label[ct_cells])[1])) /
      n_true * 100 else NA,
    # Pct miscalled as Macrophages
    Pct_Mac    = tp / n_true * 100,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  filter(N >= 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(Prevalence))

# Broad lineage for color
lineage_colors_simple <- c(
  "Macrophages"        = "#C0392B",
  "Monocytes"          = "#E67E22",
  "Neutrophils"        = "#0072B2",
  "DCs"                = "#56B4E9",
  "Lymphoid"           = "#2980B9",
  "Endothelial"        = "#27AE60",
  "Fibroblast/Stromal" = "#8E44AD",
  "VSMCs"              = "#E91E8C",
  "Cardiomyocytes"     = "#7A9134",
  "Other"              = "grey70"
)

# Scatter: prevalence vs % miscalled as macrophages
cor_test <- cor.test(prev_prec_df$Prevalence,
                      prev_prec_df$Pct_Mac,
                      method = "spearman")

p_prev_prec <- ggplot(prev_prec_df,
                       aes(x = Prevalence, y = Pct_Mac,
                           color = Lineage, size = N)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color     = "black",
              fill      = "grey92",
              linewidth = 0.6,
              alpha     = 0.4,
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = Prevalence, y = Pct_Mac)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.95, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = CellType),
                  size               = 2.5,
                  fontface           = "italic",
                  color              = "black",
                  max.overlaps       = 30,
                  seed               = 42,
                  box.padding        = 0.5,
                  point.padding      = 0.3,
                  segment.size       = 0.25,
                  segment.color      = "grey60",
                  min.segment.length = 0.2,
                  force              = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lineage_colors_simple,
                     name   = "Lineage",
                     guide  = guide_legend(
                       override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 9),
                         name  = "Cell count",
                         guide = guide_legend(
                           override.aes = list(color = "grey40"))) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = max(prev_prec_df$Prevalence) * 0.55,
           y     = min(prev_prec_df$Pct_Mac, na.rm = TRUE) + 5,
           label = sprintf("Spearman r = %.2f\np = %.3f",
                            cor_test$estimate, cor_test$p.value),
           size      = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
           hjust     = 0, vjust = 0,
           color     = "black") +

  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0),
                      limits = c(-5,
                                  max(prev_prec_df$Pct_Mac,
                                      na.rm = TRUE) * 1.12),
                      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                                      face = "bold"),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 10, color = "black",
                                      face = "bold"),
    axis.line         = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size   = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 8, 10)
  ) +
  xlab("Cell type prevalence") +

p_prev_prec
```

```{r Sensitivity Precision F1 table}

#Defining cell types and expected ImmGen broad labels
validation_types <- data.frame(
  CellType       = c("CCR2+ Mac","ARG1+ Mac","MHCII Mac","TLF Mac",
                      "Prolif TLF Mac","Ly6C-hi Mono","Ly6C-lo Mono",
                      "B Cells","NKT","Neutrophils","DCs"),
  Expected_broad = c("Macrophages","Macrophages","Macrophages","Macrophages",
                      "Macrophages","Monocytes","Monocytes",
                      "Lymphoid","Lymphoid","Neutrophils","DCs"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

#Calculating metrics per cell type
metrics_df <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(validation_types)), function(i) {
  ct       <- validation_types$CellType[i]
  expected <- validation_types$Expected_broad[i]

  ct_cells     <- comp_df$custom_label == ct
  n_true       <- sum(ct_cells)
  immgen_calls <- comp_df$immgen_broad == expected
  tp           <- sum(ct_cells & immgen_calls)

  sensitivity <- if (n_true > 0) tp / n_true else 0
  precision   <- if (sum(immgen_calls) > 0) tp / sum(immgen_calls) else 0
  f1          <- if (sensitivity + precision > 0)
                   2 * sensitivity * precision / (sensitivity + precision) else 0

  data.frame(
    CellType    = ct,
    Sensitivity = round(sensitivity * 100, 1),
    Precision   = round(precision   * 100, 1),
    F1          = round(f1          * 100, 1),
    N           = n_true,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

#Weighted F1 
total_assigned        <- sum(metrics_df$N)
metrics_df$Weight     <- metrics_df$N / total_assigned
metrics_df$F1_weighted <- metrics_df$F1 * metrics_df$Weight

weighted_f1_overall <- sum(metrics_df$F1_weighted)

#Save metrics
cat("\n=== Validation Metrics ===\n")
print(metrics_df[, c("CellType","N","Sensitivity","Precision",
                      "F1","Weight","F1_weighted")])
cat("\nUnweighted mean F1:", round(mean(metrics_df$F1), 1), "%\n")
cat("Weighted mean F1:  ", round(weighted_f1_overall, 1), "%\n")

write.csv(metrics_df,
          file.path(comparison_dir, "validation_metrics.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

#Order by weighted F1 
metrics_df <- metrics_df %>% arrange(desc(F1_weighted))

# Pivot for plotting
metrics_long <- metrics_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = c("Sensitivity","Precision","F1"),
                       names_to  = "Metric",
                       values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    CellType = factor(CellType, levels = metrics_df$CellType),
    Metric   = factor(Metric,
                      levels = c("Sensitivity","Precision","F1"))
  )

#Plot
p_metrics <- ggplot(metrics_long,
                     aes(x = CellType, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge",
           width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Sensitivity" = "#2980B9",
               "Precision"   = "#27AE60",
               "F1"          = "#C0392B"),
    guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = NA))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 118),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  geom_text(data = metrics_df,
            aes(x = CellType, y = 110,
                label = paste0("n=", N)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 2.2, color = "grey30",
            fontface = "italic") +
  # Weighted F1 annotation
  annotate("text",
           x     = length(unique(metrics_long$CellType)) * 0.55,
           y     = 116,
           label = paste0("Weighted F1 = ",
                           round(weighted_f1_overall, 1), "%"),
           size = 3, fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 0, color = "black") +
  bar_pub_theme() +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("ImmGen annotation accuracy (%)")

p_metrics

save_pub(p_metrics, "Fig7_Sensitivity_Precision_F1_weighted",
         comparison_dir, width = 240, height = 120)


```



```{r Proportion comparison: Custom vs ImmGen}

# Custom proportions
prop_custom <- comp_df %>%
  filter(custom_label != "Unassigned") %>%
  count(sample, custom_broad) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = custom_broad) %>%
  mutate(Classifier = "Custom")

# ImmGen proportions
prop_immgen <- comp_df %>%
  count(sample, immgen_broad) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = immgen_broad) %>%
  mutate(Classifier = "ImmGen")

prop_combined <- bind_rows(prop_custom, prop_immgen) %>%
  filter(!CellType %in% c("Unassigned","Other")) %>%
  mutate(Classifier = factor(Classifier,
                              levels = c("Custom","ImmGen")))

p_prop_compare <- ggplot(prop_combined,
                          aes(x = reorder(CellType, -pct),
                              y = pct,
                              fill = Classifier)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge",
           width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~sample, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Custom" = "#2C7FB8",
                                "ImmGen" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  bar_pub_theme() +
  theme(strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  xlab("") + ylab("% of total cells")

p_prop_compare



save_pub(p_prop_compare, "Fig8_Proportion_Custom_vs_ImmGen",
         comparison_dir, width = 260, height = 120)
```
